text:
maya: quick sync — catalog launch is T-6 days. Need a short status on three things before we freeze: (1) licensing clearance for new open models, (2) perf profiles + baseline benchmarks uploaded, (3) owner for rollout canary and CR queue. cc @lee @priya @samir
lee: Licensing: calypso-7b has CC-BY-4.0 + contributor CLA accepted, good to go. orchid-3b-lite still needs the CLA from upstream author — pinged yesterday. fenrir-2.1 has a pending dual-license question. @legal-bot any update?
legal-bot: fenrir-2.1 flagged: upstream repo contains a non-commercial clause in one submodule. Need legal review to confirm compatibility with our distribution. ETA 48h.
priya: Perf: I ran the daily perf sweep on calypso + fenrir on p4dn. calypso 1.8x tokens/sec vs baseline, memory looks stable. fenrir-2.1 shows KV cache blowup at 8k context in our runner, investigating. orchid-3b-lite is fast but attention kernel mismatch causes 10% variance. Uploaded raw logs to the perf bucket: s3://redwood-perf/catalog/1735/
samir: Owners: I can take canary for calypso + orchid if priya and zhao pair on preflight fixes. fenrir needs deeper runtime work; suggest we gate fenrir to dedicated-only until KV issue is fixed.
zhao: ACK. For canary I can do the deployment window Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Need the rollout policy: prefer 5% traffic, auto-rollback on 5xx spike > 0.5% or latency p95 regress > 50ms.
maya: sounds good. Action items: (A) @legal-bot to confirm fenrir license compatibility (48h), (B) @priya to finish KV root-cause or list mitigations (24h), (C) @samir & @zhao to schedule canary for calypso/orchid (confirm slot), (D) I will prepare release notes and model profiles doc.
lee: small ask — can we get the perf-profile JSONs into the catalog manifest before canary? Format is in the docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-catalog/profiles
priya: yes, I'll push profiles after KV triage. Example snippet I'm generating:
```json
{"model": "calypso-7b", "throughput": "1.8x", "p95_latency_ms": "120", "memory_peak_gb": "42"}
```
samir: FYI, CR queue: I have two open PRs for inference runner tweaks (batching timeout, kv compact). If owners approve today they can land before canary. review links: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/1423 https://git.redwood/infra/pr/1424
zhao: +1 for landing both. maya: i'll block the canary slot once those PRs are merged and perf profiles are in.
maya: if legal flags fenrir as incompatible we will defer fenrir to next sprint and roll calypso + orchid only. Please post quick one-line updates in this thread so I can compile into the launch checklist doc. :thumbsup:
lee: noted, I'll add a note to the checklist for manifest + profiles.
priya: updating thread now — KV root cause is a memory leak in our kv-evict path, have a patch, running a short stress test. should update in 6h.
legal-bot: fenrir-2.1 review: submodule license is non-commercial; need upstream clarification. Recommend requesting relicense or vendor-only hosting.
maya: thanks. tagging next steps in the checklist. If anyone needs a pairing session on the KV fix ping me and i'll book.
samir: thumbs up. landing PRs now, will @-reply when merged.
lee: merging checklist: calypso (green), orchid (waiting CLA), fenrir (legal uncertain).
maya: great — please do 1-line pings here when your tasks finish so I can close the loop in the release notes.
